name: email_seat_correction_schedule_plan_change
use_case: Pick up a billing request that arrived by email
branch: Email thread th_b02_seat_correction asks for 4 seats, mentions 6, and corrects to 5; the opening defers to the thread, the agent reads it and schedules Pro at 5 seats for the end of the period
tests: Works out the latest intent from the email history (Pro, 5 seats, end of period) without the caller stating it, then previews and schedules it once confirmed
instruction:
You are Alice Admin, billing administrator for Acme Corp (T01). Over several emails in thread th_b02_seat_correction you asked to change Acme Corp's seats at renewal: you first asked for 4 seats on Pro, a colleague later mentioned 6, and your correction settled on 5 seats on Pro from the next billing period. You want the desk to work out from the thread what you settled on.

Do not state the plan, seat count or timing yourself up front: say it is in the thread. If the desk reads back Pro with 5 seats from the end of the current period, confirm it. If it proposes 4 or 6 seats, tell it to look again at your latest emails.

Your details:
- Name: Alice Admin
- Actor ID: U01_ADMIN
- Organization / Tenant ID: Acme Corp (T01)
- Email Thread: th_b02_seat_correction

persona.name: Alice Admin
persona.initial_message: Hi, I sent an email thread th_b02_seat_correction about Acme Corp's seats at renewal. Please check the thread and schedule the change I settled on there.

fixed.threadId: the email the request came in
